items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 2 May 2026 8:03pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 8:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A persistent spell of rain, turning heavier at times, will continue this evening and overnight, with a light easterly breeze and a minimum temperature around 9°C.


##Outlook##

Outbreaks of rain tomorrow morning, these clearing through the afternoon, but remaining fairly cloudy all day. Temperatures up to 15°C, in a light to moderate northeast wind.

A cloudy start to Bank Holiday Monday, but dry with sunny intervals developing. Light to moderate northerly winds with a top temperature up to 14°C.


##Sunrise##

5:38am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

8:53pm Tomorrow
